title: Paris Basketball claim Betclic ELITE ProA title
description: Paris - Monaco 99-93 Paris Basketball claimed Elite ProA title. They went on a furious run in the fourth quarter to snatch the victory against Monaco in the decisive fifth game of the championship series. Monaco was trailing by 4 points at halftime but managed to get 8-point lead after three quarters before a 26-12 charge of Paris Basket, which allowed them to win the game. 26 personal fouls committed by Monaco helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. American-North Macedonian point guard TJ Shorts (175-1997, college: UC Davis) orchestrated the victory with a double-double by scoring 27 points, 7 rebounds and 10 assists. The former international guard Nadir Hifi (188-2002) contributed with 16 points for the winners.
